```artifact
Feature: Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs
  As an administrator,
  I want to manage doctors and chemists/labs,
  So that I can ensure accurate and up-to-date information.

  Scenario: Attempt to add a doctor with a non-existent speciality
    Given the speciality with Speciality Id does not exist
    When I attempt to add a doctor with a non-existent Speciality Id
    Then an exception error message "Speciality does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Access Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors
    Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
    Then I see options to "Add Doctors" and "Edit/Update Doctors"

  Scenario: Access Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given I am on the Administrators Menu Screen
    Then I see options to "Add Chemist / Labs" and "Edit/Update Chemist/ Labs"

  Scenario Outline: Add a doctor with valid details
    Given I am on the Add Doctor Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <Doctor Name> | <Age> | <Sex> | <Qualification> | <Experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then a Doctor Id is generated and displayed
    And the doctor details are saved successfully

    Examples:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | Dr. Smith   | 45  | M   | MBBS          | 10         |
      | Dr. Doe     | 30  | F   | MD            | 5          |
      | Dr. Brown   | 50  | M   | MS            | 15         |

  Scenario Outline: Edit/Update a doctor with valid details
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And I query the doctor with Doctor Id <Doctor Id>
    When I modify the following details:
      | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | <Doctor Name> | <Age> | <Sex> | <Qualification> | <Experience> |
    And I submit the form
    Then the doctor details are updated successfully

    Examples:
      | Doctor Id | Doctor Name | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience |
      | 1         | Dr. Smith   | 46  | M   | MBBS          | 11         |
      | 2         | Dr. Doe     | 31  | F   | MD            | 6          |
      | 3         | Dr. Brown   | 51  | M   | MS            | 16         |

  Scenario: Attempt to edit/update a non-existent doctor
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    When I query the doctor with a non-existent Doctor Id
    Then an exception error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Attempt to delete a doctor with open consultation requests
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And the doctor with Doctor Id 1 has open consultation requests
    When I attempt to delete the doctor with Doctor Id 1
    Then an exception error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

  Scenario: Successfully delete a doctor without open consultation requests
    Given I am on the Edit/Update Doctors Screen
    And the doctor with Doctor Id 2 has no open consultation requests
    When I delete the doctor with Doctor Id 2
    Then the doctor details are deleted successfully

  Scenario Outline: Add a chemist/lab with valid details
    Given I am on the Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    When I enter the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | <Chemist/Lab Flag> | <Chemist Lab Name> | <Chemist Lab Address> | <Chemist Lab Contact Details> |
    And I submit the form
    Then a Chemist/Lab Id is generated and displayed
    And the chemist/lab details are saved successfully

    Examples:
      | Chemist/Lab Flag | Chemist Lab Name | Chemist Lab Address | Chemist Lab Contact Details |
      | Chemist          | Lab A            | Address A           | Contact A                   |
      | Lab              | Lab B            | Address B           | Contact B                   |
      | Chemist          | Lab C            | Address C           | Contact C                   |
```
